goal: Prevent wallet PSBT signing from producing detached SIGHASH_SINGLE signatures when no matching output exists.
Protect users from signing transactions whose outputs can be swapped without invalidating the signature.
agreement: Strong support with approvals from achow101 and l0rinc with no objections.

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents a fund-safety hazard during PSBT signing where invalid SIGHASH_SINGLE inputs could allow funds to be redirected.
Consolidates signing checks into CreateSig so all wallet signing paths consistently reject detached signatures.

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because the change affects wallet signing validation logic rather than the RPC layer or interface design.

result.summary: This PR moves the check that prevents signing SIGHASH_SINGLE inputs with no matching output index into MutableTransactionSignatureCreator::CreateSig. Previously, SignTransaction skipped these inputs but SignPSBTInput did not, leaving walletprocesspsbt open to creating detached signatures. Functional tests in rpc_psbt.py are added to verify PSBT signing rejects them.
result.problem: When an input uses SIGHASH_SINGLE but has no corresponding output index, the signature commits to no outputs (or a fixed hash), leaving it valid even if transaction outputs are modified. SignTransaction guarded against this, but walletprocesspsbt still signed such inputs, risking fund theft if a user was tricked into signing a malicious PSBT.

result.card: This PR moves the safety check that rejects SIGHASH_SINGLE inputs with no matching output index into MutableTransactionSignatureCreator::CreateSig. While direct transaction signing already checked for this, PSBT signing did not, allowing walletprocesspsbt to create detached signatures that commit to no outputs and risk fund theft. achow101 ACKed a previous commit and l0rinc Concept ACKed, with no objections raised. The PR is ready for final review and merge.
